scripts.check:push: vp run typegen:all && vp run --filter eslint-local-rules-shared build && vp check && vp run typecheck:changed && vp run -r lint:eslint:check && vp run lint:biome:check && vp run react-doctor:verify && vp run commands:verify && vp run coordination:verify && vp run scripts:verify && vp run lint:plugins:verify && vp run lint:eslint:verify && vp run suppressions:verify && vp run docs:verify && vp run adr:verify && vp run viteplus:verify
scripts.check:safe: vp run typegen:all && vp run --filter eslint-local-rules-shared build && vp check && vp run typecheck:all && vp run -r lint:eslint:check && vp run lint:biome:check && vp run react-doctor:verify && vp run commands:verify && vp run coordination:verify && vp run scripts:verify && vp run lint:plugins:verify && vp run lint:eslint:verify && vp run suppressions:verify && vp run docs:verify && vp run adr:verify && vp run viteplus:verify && vp run packages:build && vp run publish:verify && vp run api-surface:verify && vp run attw:verify && vp run test:all
scripts.coordination:board:live: gh pr list --state open --json number,title,headRefName,isDraft,url,statusCheckRollup --limit 200 | node scripts/coordination-board-live.mjs
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker/local/docker-compose.yml --env-file docker/local/.env up -d postgres pgadmin
scripts.housekeeping:prune: gh pr list --state all --json number,headRefName,state --limit 400 | node scripts/housekeeping-prune.mjs
scripts.lint:all: vp run --filter eslint-local-rules-shared build && vp lint . --fix && vp run -r lint:eslint && vp run lint:biome
scripts.lint:report: vp run --filter eslint-local-rules-shared build && node scripts/generate-lint-reports.mjs
scripts.ready: vp run check:safe && vp run build:all
scripts.release:version: changeset version && vp install --lockfile-only && vp fmt .
scripts.test:all: vp run -r test && vp run test:scripts
scripts.test:ci: vp run --filter '!@repo/scan-ingestion' --filter '!@repo/scan-orchestrator' --filter '!vite-react-compiler' test && vp run --filter @repo/scan-ingestion test:unit && vp run --filter @repo/scan-orchestrator test:unit && vp run test:scripts && vp run --filter vite-react-compiler test:ci
